lastCompletedStory.title: Unify the pane-not-idle fallback onto the same verify plus remediation loop

nextStoryContext: src/tmux/dispatch.ts now has one verifyAfterPayloadSend loop for both idle-gate outcomes. The timedOut flag only selects paneWasIdle/reason metadata and gates the terminal orch-pane-busy co-emission; it never branches around geometry/prompt-row verification. Payload text is still sent once, while failed non-terminal verifies use sendBareSubmitKey. A timed-out recovery emits only push-recovered with paneWasIdle:false. The src/supervisor/events.ts orch-pane-busy prose still names the removed sendOnceUnverified helper and is intentionally left for the PRD's later diagnostic-wording story.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Current tmux documentation confirms send-keys accepts multiple argv key names, sends Enter as a key when passed separately, and makes Enter literal only under -l; the single payload send plus bare-Enter remediation matches that API.
